definition: to keep something steady so it does not fall
description: A boy in a cap and blue T-shirt runs along a gravel path past flower beds, then leaps into the arms of an elderly man outside a modern house, who swings him up off the ground. The boy and a white-haired woman tip a metal watering can together over pink dahlias in the garden. At a wooden garden table the boy leans on his elbows and carefully leans two playing cards against each other into a standing triangle, with more cards laid flat on the boards in front of him. The last shot is the whole family in the back garden, children at the picnic table and on a rug on the lawn.

taps.phrase: to run along a gravel path
